items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was with Buddy Rich’s first band with me too

ctx.x: Joel Shulman was the bass player.

Joel Shulman, right, good bass player he was. He was with Buddy Rich’s first band with me too, I forgot about him. Great bass player. Had a wonderful big round sound, he had just come back from being overseas with the premier Glenn Miller Orchestra, in the army band along with all those guys, you know.
I read somewhere a nice story about Thornhill’s rhythm section with Gil instead of Claude would rent studio time up at Nola’s and just go up there and do nothing but play time.
